lines.text: Do you know why people are using Orbi Transfer?
It's a house party. Twenty people, and you just filmed the best moment of the night.
So you try AirDrop. And honestly? AirDrop is great, if everyone has an Apple device.
But most Android phones don't show up. You switch to “Everyone for 10 minutes”, and tap people one by one. And the Windows laptop playing the music? Never appears.
With Orbi, you open the website, drop the video, set a code. One send.
And every screen at the party gets it at once. iPhone, Android, laptop. No app, no login!
So how does it know who's at the party?
Everyone here is on the same Wi-Fi. Orbi sees a scrambled fingerprint of that network, never your address, and marks your file Nearby for exactly those phones.
Every open Orbi page keeps a tiny live line to a room. You send, and a little note, not the file, rings through it. Every screen around you lights up in about a second.
Then the speed. Your video is cut into parts, and three fly at once. If the Wi-Fi drops, only the missing parts go again. And your friends pull four streams at once.
And your code? Your phone stirs it over three hundred thousand times into a key. Guessing is painfully slow, and 12 wrong tries lock the file.
Thirty minutes later, it's gone. No account. No trace.
Orbi Transfer dot com. Try it at your next party.
